sinopsis.es: La ópera prima de la artista y cineasta torontina Yuula Benivolski, The Black Box is Orange, es un ensayo autobiográfico y multiforme que recurre a la memoria personal y a archivos incompletos para pensar una infancia en un pueblo fronterizo militarizado.
sinopsis.en: The debut feature by Toronto artist and filmmaker Yuula Benivolski, The Black Box is Orange is a multimodal, autobiographical essay film that deploys both personal memory and incomplete archives to reflect on a childhood in a militarized border town.
